description: This PHP source file defines the ViewLocationController class within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. The class manages the rendering of location-related views in the admin interface, specifically initializing Vue components with country data and setting permissions.

classes.name: ViewLocationController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing location views in the admin module, initializing Vue components with country data and managing permissions.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and components before rendering, specifically setting up a Vue component with country data and configuring permissions.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns the data groups required for capability permission checks, in this case, 'locations'.
